8×8-Brett, jedes Feld hat eine von 8 Far: 8×8 board, every square has one of 8 colors. Each side has two rows of towers in 8 colors (classic: one row). Player 1 starts at the bottom (moves UP), player 2 at the top (moves DOWN).
DIE GRUNDREGEL: Die FARBE des Feldes, au: THE BASIC RULE: the COLOR of the square you land on FORCES your opponent to move a tower of EXACTLY THAT color (it glows). With two rows, everyone has two towers per color and may choose.
Die Farbe des Feldes, auf dem du landest: The color of the square you land on decides which tower your opponent has to move.
Du GEWINNST, sobald ein Turm die LETZTE: You WIN as soon as a tower reaches the LAST row on your opponent's side.
Kann kein Turm der verlangten Farbe zieh: If no tower of the required color can move, it is blocked: then the opponent must move a tower of the color of the square the blocked one stands on. If both are blocked, it's a draw.
Nur beim ERSTEN Zug darfst du einen beli: Only on the FIRST move may you choose any tower. After that the colors always decide.
